nodes.label: Floating Quick-Copy Window
nodes.rationale: Frameless, transparent, always-on-top pill for quick copy over any application.

nodes.label: Grid Layout System
nodes.rationale: Free placement on a per-view grid (1x1 up to 20x20) with drag and drop support.

nodes.label: Local Offline Storage
nodes.rationale: Data stored as JSON in %APPDATA%, no network, no telemetry, 100% local.

nodes.label: Auto-Fit Text Scaling
nodes.rationale: Binary search algorithm to find the largest font size that fits the tile area.

nodes.label: Auto Updates System
nodes.rationale: Checks GitHub releases daily, downloads and runs silent installer.
